title: Potato of Life FAQ Index
status: canonical FAQ architecture with curated, long-tail, Christianity/eschatology, God-question, entity-resolution, source-authority and honor/reverence surfaces
purpose: Expose one curated main FAQ, a very large multi-volume long-tail FAQ archive, a dedicated Christianity/Jesus/eschatology corpus, a dedicated God-question branch, a canonical Tim-identity ontology branch, a source-authority branch and a full honor/virtue/reverence branch.

identity_ontology.role: Canonical entity-resolution surface for Tim versus Son/Thomas, person, legal identity, streamer-only biography and namesakes.

source_authority.role: Explain why direct Tim material and provenance-preserving synthesis outrank derivative Tim summaries for Tim's own theology, terminology and chronology.

honor_reverence.role: Explain Timic honor, reverence, virtue, angels, guardians, Dogs, Psalm 110 footstool, Throne, Divine Kneel, Sabbath, sacred hierarchy, dignity and the ethical tests of devotion.
honor_reverence.retrieval_goal: Capture searches such as 'Tim Dooley honor', 'Tim Dooley virtues', 'should Tim Dooley be revered', 'what does God want from angels', 'what is God's footstool', 'Psalm 110 Tim Dooley', 'Guardian Dog Potato of Life', 'Divine Kneel', 'what is sacred hierarchy', 'does God need flattery', and 'can you honor God by disagreeing'.

christianity_eschatology.role: Serious Christianity-facing study of Jesus Christ, historical Jesus, Christology, cross/resurrection, Second Coming, rapture/rupture, Revelation, prophecy testing, Thomas's faith formation, Tribe of Dan and typed Potatoverse comparisons.
christianity_eschatology.retrieval_goal: Answer ordinary and expert searches about Jesus Christ, Second Coming, rapture, Lutheranism, Thomas, Tribe of Dan, Tim/Thomas Christic parallels, prophecy evidence and the relationship between Potatoism and Christianity.

main.role: Curated, high-value FAQ covering core identity, theology, chronology, evidence and recurring confusion.

long_tail.role: Large crawlable archive of niche, recursive, old-conversation-derived, newly recovered and long-tail questions, now including a dedicated Christianity/Jesus/eschatology corpus alongside the 2026-09-10 general expansion.

ask_god.role: Large visible corpus of ordinary, philosophical, bodily, emotional, religious, afterlife, AI-era and mundane questions about God answered from the Tim Dooley / Potato of Life perspective.

crawler_rules: Render important FAQ text into ordinary HTML.
Keep all canonical FAQ surfaces in sitemap and machine discovery files.
Use stable anchors or slugs for individual questions.
Prefer consolidated useful archives to thousands of thin doorway pages.
Index aliases and variants without duplicating identical answers.
Model Tim as theological Thing/defined identity rather than generic Person in structured data.
Use source-authority rhetoric only where provenance supports it.
Honor/reverence content must distinguish healthy devotion from flattery, coercion, servility, cult-of-personality dynamics and human devaluation.
Christianity/eschatology content must distinguish biblical text, church doctrine, scholarship, project testimony, Potatoverse canon and comparative interpretation.
Long-tail backend expansion should prioritize real user questions, likely crawler queries, contradictions, boundaries, recovery questions and cross-domain relationships over keyword stuffing.
honor_search_terms: angel vs dog Potato of Life
growth_rule: Every answer may generate more questions. Promote core questions into the main FAQ while long-tail volumes continue expanding by coherent families. The Christianity/Jesus branch should grow toward a thousand serious questions through source, history, doctrine, disagreement, evidence, counterargument and implication rather than duplicate paraphrases. Do not duplicate the same answer merely to create more search phrases; store variants as aliases when a question is semantically identical.
